title_zh: v215：观测代理 Warm Replay 因 K16 参考不足而不可判定
title_en: v215: observation-proxy warm replay is inconclusive because the K16 reference is inadequate
interpretation_zh: v215 已把 observation/geometry-only 代理接入未修改 CGLS 并完成 546 个物理重放，但 Zero-K16 参考只有 466/546 单元、1/13 几何通过自身绝对门；80 个失败全部来自内部梯度。独立实现复现全部数组、调用账和同一不可判定结论，因此当前不能合法判断代理 warm start 成败。
interpretation_en: v215 connects the observation/geometry-only proxy to unchanged CGLS and completes 546 physical replays, but the Zero-K16 reference passes its own absolute gates in only 466/546 cells and 1/13 geometries; all 80 failures are interior-gradient only. The independent implementation reproduces every array, call ledger, and the same inconclusive decision, so the proxy warm start cannot yet be adjudicated validly.
route_action_zh: 另行结果前冻结 reference qualification。只有新 reference 在同一 13 套几何和 42 帧上独立通过四项充分性门，才重新裁决 warm start；不得在 v215 内事后改 K、门槛或控制。
route_action_en: Freeze a separate reference-qualification gate before results. Re-adjudicate the warm start only after a new reference independently passes all four adequacy gates on the same 13 geometries and 42 frames; do not change K, thresholds, or controls post hoc inside v215.
